outcomeAssessment.formalCriterionDistinction: FINAL-001 marked criteria 1 and 9 met and failed criterion 3. The written timing/profile obligations and the broader net workflow objective are separate judgments.

futureOperatingValueModel.kind: conditional arithmetic, not a forecast or measured saving
futureOperatingValueModel.assumptions: The gate counts are illustrative. Recorded phase median differences are assumed representative; their source workloads and host activity were not a controlled equal-work comparison.
limits: Reuse frequency and its overhead across fifty future orders have not been measured.
The observed review median increase is not a matched recurring penalty and is not multiplied by fifty.
Full review is always fresh. Only eligible non-review invocations/tasks can contribute reuse savings.
Historical development, failed gates and repair costs remain recorded separately; no hypothetical future gain is booked against them.
An unknown aggregate benefit is not evidence that the change is useless or that further optimization is impossible.
Net reuse counts work beyond the two assumed fresh plain gates; no invocation is counted as both fresh and skipped. The 422.027-second scenario assumes zero lookup overhead.
